sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026, including the complete original July PDF. Model dependencies explicitly identifies Gemini 3.5 Flash as its base, and the architecture/training sections delegate to that card. Neither the original card nor its benchmark and safety tables gives a numerical total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash API model specification
sources.evidence: Exact stable model code gemini-3.6-flash: 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens; text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs and text output. Thinking and function calling are supported. Reopened October 27, 2026: no numerical total or active parameter count appears in its specification table.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
sources.evidence: July 21, 2026 announcement says 3.6 Flash is available starting that day. Reopened October 27: it describes improved coding, multimodal work and fewer generated tokens relative to 3.5 Flash, without a numerical model size. Token-use reductions are not parameter-count reductions.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text check of the exact named base. The card explicitly identifies Gemini 3 Flash as its dependency and architecture reference. Its comparisons report benchmarks and safety results, with no total or activated-parameter count to inherit.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card, December 2025
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text check of the complete December 2025 card. Model dependencies and architecture explicitly name Gemini 3 Pro. No numerical total or active parameter count appears for this base.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text check of the complete May 2026 revision. The final named base is a sparse MoE Transformer and is explicitly not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model. Routing is qualitative; no numerical total, activated count or expert dimensions are supplied.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms for the hosted Gemini API prohibit extracting or replicating underlying model weights. Together with the exact model distribution section, supports a proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash model card, August 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check of the complete card. It explicitly identifies 3.6 Flash as its base and includes an exact benchmark comparison column. Price, benchmark and safety rows supply no total or activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card, September 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check of the complete card. Its base is 3.7 Flash; model information and benchmark/safety comparisons supply no retrospective total or active count for 3.6 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card, October 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check of the complete decoded card. Argon is explicitly a new model rather than a prior-model fine-tune. No numerical total or active count for Gemini 3.6 Flash is supplied.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3.6 Flash record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog lead inspected. Primary Google sources independently establish the model identity and public specifications; this catalog does not establish internal parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text review of every parameter and Gemini 3.6 Flash occurrence. The two exact-model references concern selecting sandbox side tasks solvable by 3.6 Flash. Parameter mentions concern evaluation difficulty, protecting weights or encoded knowledge; no numerical total or active size is disclosed.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash — Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search located and reopened this complete Cloud specification on October 27. It gives the stable ID, capabilities, limits and July 21 release, but no total or active weight count. Its parameter defaults concern sampling controls, not model size.

name.note: Official name of stable gemini-3.6-flash; distinct from 3.5 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite.

developer.note: Released by Google and documented by Google DeepMind.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family key for the official Gemini Flash series.

release_date.note: The dated announcement explicitly says available starting today; confirms earliest public launch, not a later provider rollout.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted apps/APIs under Google terms; downloadable model weights are not distributed in the primary materials.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access governed by Google service terms; documentation/code licenses are not model-weight licenses.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total-size and named-base searches, original evidence and later Google comparisons found no supported nominal total. The 3.6 Flash → 3.5 Flash → 3 Flash → 3 Pro dependency chain is explicit, but no named base supplies a published count to inherit. Null reflects absent numerical evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-parameter searches and later comparison-table checks found no numerical active count for this model or its named bases. Sparse routing is qualitative, without expert dimensions or routing width. Later cards report benchmarks, price and safety; reduced output tokens and API sampling parameters do not establish active weight counts.

architecture.note: Explicit Architecture references: 3.6 Flash -> 3.5 Flash -> Gemini 3 Flash -> Gemini 3 Pro. The final referenced card specifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This establishes architecture class only, not expert counts or identical size.

context_window.note: Exact API input-token limit; separate output maximum is 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: Matches the exact stable API model supported input/output data types; PDF is retained as the catalog input-format convention.

reasoning.note: Model card calls it a reasoning model and API capability table supports Thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact API model specification explicitly supports function calling.

description.value: Gemini Flash model for coding and multimodal tasks, with text output, thinking and function calling.
description.note: Replaces broad speed/cost marketing with supported model purpose, output type and capability.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer based on Gemini 3.5 Flash, whose documented base chain leads through Gemini 3 Flash to Gemini 3 Pro. Total and active parameter counts are undisclosed for this model and its named bases in the reviewed sources.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: retain explicit null total and active counts after fresh exact-model searches, reopened original card/PDF, API and launch evidence, named-base review, and later Google comparisons. The dependency chain is explicit but supplies no count. Added current Cloud specification and Argon safety-report evidence; preserved every unrelated field assessment.
